newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 12.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 12.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Monday after storms subsided in the Gulf of Mexico, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
Crude port Dos Bocas reopened Monday at 0635 local/1135 GMT after closing Saturday amid regional storms.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.
Light isolated rains along most of coastline. Maximum winds at 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) with waves three to five feet high.
Cloudy with electric storms along the northern gulf. Scattered showers along coasts of Tamaulipas, Veracruz, Tabasco and Campeche.
Clear skies along the rest of the coast with winds 10 to 15 knots and waves three to five feet high.
Partly cloudy with isolated rains and gusty winds along Quintana Roo coast. Winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
